newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't to auction 200,000 coffee bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't to auction 200,000 coffee bags.

text.p: The next auction of Brazilian government coffee stocks will total about 200,000 60-kg bags, said the head of the primary commodities department of Industry and Commerce Ministry.
"The idea is to sell a little more than previously. It should be around 200,000 bags," said Mauricio Assis.
The auction, to be held Feb 5, would be the latest in a series of monthly sales through the July-June crop year.
Roasters and exporters have been pushing the government to increase sales to the current limit of 200,000 bags and some would also like the limit to be raised.

Assis declined to say, however, whether the size of auctions would be increased in the coming months. "We have an auction and then we analyse it afterwards. I can't say what will happen over next three to four months," he said. ((--Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 2230358))
